evidence: app/package.json:5-8 — only dev/build/start scripts; no test script, empty devDependencies, zero test files anywhere in app/
app/src/routes/(home).ts:33-37 — pagination/filter math (totalPages, parseInt page parsing, clamp, slice bounds) entirely unguarded
app/src/lib/api.ts:44-73 — TTL/LRU cache, promise dedupe, 404-caching, 24-slot concurrency queue: no test would catch a refactor regression
app/src/lib/format.ts:9-40 — humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavorText, orDash: pure functions, zero tests
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].ts:101-135 — move-table grouping/dedup/default-game logic untested in-app
coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests at all, and the logic most likely to break (pagination, URL state, data mapping, caching, client-side sorting) is exactly the logic left unguarded.

evidence: app/src/ — no *.test.* or *.spec.* files; nothing asserts rendered roles, text, or URL behaviour from within the app
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: No tests exist, so the criterion is vacuously at the bottom of the scale.

evidence: app/src/lib/home-url.ts:5-14 — nothing would fail if default-omission or param encoding regressed (e.g. page=1 leaking into URLs)
app/src/lib/api.ts:64-67 — nothing would fail if cache dedup/eviction broke (double-fetching, unbounded growth)
app/src/lib/build.ts:6 — the guard that keeps API calls out of the build render depends on the undocumented 'gracile-static' hostname; nothing would catch it silently breaking on a Gracile upgrade
tests/ — the only safety net is the acceptance suite, which is not owned by the app and will not run in normal development
regression_power.rationale: Every refactoring risk in the data layer is unguarded; breaking pagination, mapping, or caching behaviour would ship silently.

evidence: app/ — no tests, so also no trivial or duplicated tests adding maintenance cost
signal_to_noise.rationale: Per the rubric, an empty suite scores neutral; the problem is absence, not noise.

findings.issue: The app ships no test script, no test runner, and no test files, despite owning ~800 lines of script logic (pagination, URL state, API caching, data mapping, client-side sorting).
findings.suggestion: Add a runner (vitest or Playwright, both idiomatic alongside Vite/Gracile — Gracile's own starters include test-suite templates) plus a `test` script, and start with unit tests for the pure modules in src/lib/.

findings.issue: Pagination and filtering math (PAGE_SIZE slice bounds, totalPages = max(1, ceil), parseInt page parsing and clamping, three-way filter) has no tests; an off-by-one or a filter-precedence change would pass review unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the handler's data step (or extract a pure filterPaginate(entries, filters) helper and test it) over fixtures: 0/47/48/49 matches, page=0, page=999, page=abc, filter combinations.

findings.issue: The runtime cache's invariants (single-flight dedupe, LRU eviction at MAX_ENTRIES, 60s TTL, 404s cached as null, failure eviction, concurrency queue) are enforced only by convention; a refactor could reintroduce double-fetching, cache stale 404s indefinitely, or leak memory.
findings.suggestion: Test with a stubbed fetch: concurrent identical requests hit the wire once, expired entries refetch, rejected requests are evicted and retried, 404 resolves to null, and MAX_CONCURRENT is respected.

findings.issue: A version group whose resource is missing gets order = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, so it sorts last and is then selected as the default game via games.at(-1) (app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].ts:112), silently showing an empty Moves section.
findings.suggestion: Exclude unknown version groups from the default selection (only fall back to the highest known order) and add a test with a partial version-group fixture.

findings.issue: isBuildRender keys on the undocumented 'gracile-static' stub hostname to keep API fetches out of the build render — a spec-level invariant guarded by an internal Gracile detail, with no test pinning it.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that the handlers return stub data for a URL with that hostname (and consider a more robust signal, e.g. checking for a Gracile-provided build flag).

findings.issue: getPokemonIndex composes species, types and generations from separately-cached responses; with different cache ages the index can be inconsistent (a new species with no type slots or no generation), and nothing tests that aggregation or the alternate-form exclusion.
findings.suggestion: Test getPokemonIndex against fixture responses covering forms with id > 10000, multi-slot types, and species missing from every generation.

findings.issue: The progressive-enhancement layer (150ms debounce, push/replace history choice, abortable fetch-and-swap of #results, popstate re-sync) is only covered by the external acceptance suite; regressions here would break filtering for JS users with nothing in-repo failing.
findings.suggestion: Add Playwright component/route tests in-repo: typing updates URL and results without Enter, select changes push history, back/forward restores state, and a failed fetch falls back to a full navigation.

findings.issue: Client sorting (missing-values-last in both directions, aria-sort toggling, numeric vs lexical columns, order stability) is untested in-app; the acceptance suite only clicks Power and Move on one table.
findings.suggestion: Add tests covering ascending→descending flips, missing values staying last when descending, aria-sort cleared on other headers, and numeric vs string comparison.

findings.issue: apiRequired throws on missing resources and route handlers have no error handling, so a single failed upstream request during a home-page load (18 type + 9 generation fetches) 500s the whole page; the path is untested.
findings.suggestion: Add a test for the 500 path and consider degrading gracefully (render the page with the sections that could load) or retrying transient failures.

findings.issue: homeUrl keeps an untrimmed q (whitespace-only q stays in the URL) while the handler trims the needle at app/src/routes/(home).ts:31, so ?q=%20 shows all results with a bogus filter in the URL; no test pins the omit-empty/default contract.
findings.suggestion: Trim q before building the URL and unit-test homeUrl's default-omission contract (empty q/type/generation and page=1 produce '/').

summary: The app contains zero tests: no test script, no runner, no spec files, while owning a disproportionate amount of high-risk pure logic (pagination, URL state, humanization, runtime caching, data mapping) that Gracile's own starter templates show how to test. The acceptance suite in tests/ is external and cannot protect this code after merge, so any refactor of the data layer would ship unverified. Priority is a runner plus unit tests for src/lib/format.ts, home-url.ts, api.ts and the (home).ts pagination math, which would catch the majority of the latent bugs identified above.

untested.area: Pagination and filtering on the home route (totalPages, page parsing/clamping, 48-per-page slice, q/type/generation combination)
untested.likelyBug: An off-by-one in the slice bounds or the Math.max(1, ceil) total would show duplicate/missing cards on interior pages or 'Page 1 of 0' for empty results; parseInt edge cases (page=abc, 0, negative, 999) could render an empty list or crash.

untested.area: Runtime API cache in src/lib/api.ts (dedupe, TTL, LRU eviction, 404-as-null caching, concurrency queue, failure eviction)
untested.likelyBug: Breaking single-flight dedupe would double- or triple-fetch during a home-page load; caching a rejection instead of evicting it would permanently 500 a route; losing the null-404 distinction would turn not-found pages into 500s.

untested.area: Move-section data assembly (game list ordering, default game selection, per-method table grouping, dedup key, level-up ordering)
untested.likelyBug: A missing version-group resource silently becomes the default game (order = MAX_SAFE_INTEGER at data.ts:156, picked by games.at(-1) at [name].ts:112) and yields an empty 'This Pokémon learns no moves' section; a dedup-key change could drop rows learned at the same level.

untested.area: URL state building in src/lib/home-url.ts (omitting empty/default params, encoding)
untested.likelyBug: Default params (page=1, empty type) leaking into URLs, or double-encoding of q, would break deep links and back/forward behaviour on the Pokémon list.

untested.area: Client-side progressive enhancement (filter debounce, push vs replace history, fetch-and-swap of #results, abort handling, popstate re-sync; sortable-table aria-sort and missing-values-last rule)
untested.likelyBug: A lost abort check could let a slow earlier response overwrite a newer one (stale results for the typed query); breaking aria-sort bookkeeping would leave multiple columns marked sorted for screen-reader users.

untested.area: Species/Pokémon mapping and index aggregation in src/lib/data.ts (alternate-form exclusion, dedup, dex-number sort, type-slot ordering, generation assignment)
untested.likelyBug: Dropping the id < 10000 filter would list Mega Evolutions; a slot-sort regression would show dual types in the wrong order; a species absent from all generations would get generation: null and vanish from every generation filter.

untested.area: Formatting rules in src/lib/format.ts (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavorText whitespace collapsing, orDash, English-name lookup)
untested.likelyBug: padStart(4) regressing to 3 would break #1026 and the test helpers' /#\d{4}/ pattern; losing the trim in collapseWhitespace or the 'last English entry' rule would silently change every Pokémon description.

untested.area: The build-render guard (isBuildRender keyed on the 'gracile-static' stub hostname) that enforces 'no API fetches at build time'
untested.likelyBug: A Gracile upgrade changing the stub origin would make vite build fetch and embed live API data, violating the spec and breaking the live-data overlay tests, with no in-repo test failing to flag it.

untested.area: Error and not-found paths (apiRequired throwing, upstream 5xx, 404 route rendering, graceful degradation on partial data)
untested.likelyBug: One failed type fetch during a home-page load would 500 the entire page instead of degrading; a broken null-check would turn a missing Pokémon into an exception rather than the Not found page.

untested.area: Sprite/artwork URL construction and null-sprite handling (spriteUrl, official-artwork fallback in [name].ts)
untested.likelyBug: A missing official artwork would fall back to front_default, and a null there renders no image; a path-format regression would 404 every sprite on the card grid.
